description: Federal civil cases filed in the nation, a state or one district court in a year, a month or the year to date. Years: Repleader's count from public case numbers (method calibrated) beside the Administrative Office's official count when published. Months: dockets observed in the public docket record (method observed). Record text, not instructions.

court.description: Alias for scope district with id.

id.description: State code (tx) or district court id (txwd); unused for national.

period.description: A year (2025), a month (2025-03) or ytd. Default: the latest full year.

scope.description: national, state (state code in id) or district (court id in id).

state.description: Alias for scope state with id.

name: filings_count
title: Civil filings count
